description: This file implements a deprecated WebSocket-based real-time LLM service for OpenAI, handling audio and text streams, WebSocket communication, event processing, and conversation management within the pipecat framework.

classes.name: CurrentAudioResponse
classes.description: Data class tracking the current audio response from the assistant, including item ID, content index, start time, and total size.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeBetaLLMService
classes.description: A deprecated WebSocket-based real-time LLM service for OpenAI, managing audio/text streams, WebSocket connection, event handling, and conversation state within the pipecat framework.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates if the service supports generating usage metrics.

methods.name: set_audio_input_paused
methods.description: Sets whether audio input is paused.

methods.name: _is_modality_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific modality ('text' or 'audio') is enabled.

methods.name: _get_enabled_modalities
methods.description: Returns the list of enabled modalities.

methods.name: retrieve_conversation_item
methods.description: Retrieves a conversation item by ID from the server asynchronously.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service and establishes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the service and closes WebSocket connection.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the service and disconnects.

methods.name: _handle_interruption
methods.description: Handles interruption events, clearing buffers and stopping metrics.

methods.name: _handle_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when user starts speaking (not implemented).

methods.name: _handle_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when user stops speaking.

methods.name: _handle_bot_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles event when bot stops speaking.

methods.name: _calculate_audio_duration_ms
methods.description: Calculates audio duration in milliseconds from byte size and PCM parameters.

methods.name: _truncate_current_audio_response
methods.description: Truncates current audio response based on actual audio duration and wall clock time.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling different frame types for conversation and audio.

methods.name: _handle_messages_append
methods.description: Placeholder for handling appended messages.

methods.name: _handle_function_call_result
methods.description: Handles function call results from the assistant.

methods.name: send_client_event
methods.description: Sends a client event to the WebSocket API.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection and starts receive task.

methods.name: _disconnect
methods.description: Closes WebSocket connection and cancels receive task.

methods.name: _ws_send
methods.description: Sends a message over WebSocket.

methods.name: _update_settings
methods.description: Updates session settings via client event.

methods.name: _receive_task_handler
methods.description: Handles incoming WebSocket messages and dispatches events.

methods.name: _handle_evt_session_created
methods.description: Handles session creation event, configuring session properties.

methods.name: _handle_evt_session_updated
methods.description: Handles session update event, possibly triggering response creation.

methods.name: _handle_evt_audio_delta
methods.description: Handles incoming audio delta events, decoding and pushing audio frames.

methods.name: _handle_evt_audio_done
methods.description: Handles completion of audio streaming.

methods.name: _handle_evt_conversation_item_created
methods.description: Handles new conversation item creation events.

methods.name: _handle_evt_input_audio_transcription_delta
methods.description: Handles transcription delta events, pushing interim transcription frames.

methods.name: _handle_user_transcription
methods.description: Handles user transcription results (not implemented).

methods.name: handle_evt_input_audio_transcription_completed
methods.description: Handles completion of transcription, updating context and pushing final frames.

methods.name: _handle_conversation_item_retrieved
methods.description: Completes futures for retrieved conversation items.

methods.name: _handle_evt_response_done
methods.description: Handles final response event, metrics, and output processing.

methods.name: _maybe_handle_evt_retrieve_conversation_item_error
methods.description: Handles errors related to invalid conversation item retrieval.

methods.name: _handle_evt_error
methods.description: Handles fatal errors by pushing error frames.

methods.name: _handle_assistant_output
methods.description: Processes assistant output, handling function calls.

methods.name: _handle_function_call_items
methods.description: Processes function call items from assistant output.

methods.name: reset_conversation
methods.description: Resets the conversation by disconnecting and reconnecting.

methods.name: _create_response
methods.description: Creates a new response, initializing messages and settings.

methods.name: _send_user_audio
methods.description: Encodes and sends user audio over WebSocket.

methods.name: create_context_aggregator
methods.description: Creates context aggregator pair for the given LLM context.
